parameters.query:
-- 各活動中キャンペーンの基本KPIを一気に算出
with ent as (
  select campaign_id, count(*) as entries
  from campaign_entries
  where entered_at >= now() - interval '1 day'
  group by 1
),
ev as (
  select campaign_id,
    count(*) filter (where event='impression') as imps,
    count(*) filter (where event='profile_click') as prof,
    count(*) filter (where event='save') as saves,
    count(*) filter (where event='link_click') as clicks,
    count(*) filter (where event='dm_sent') as dms
  from campaign_events
  where occurred_at >= now() - interval '1 day'
  group by 1
),
cv as (
  select campaign_id,
    count(*) filter (where cv_type='purchase') as purchases,
    coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where cv_type='purchase'), 0) as revenue,
    count(*) filter (where cv_type='line_add') as line_adds,
    count(*) filter (where cv_type='lead_magnet_dl') as dls
  from campaign_conversions
  where occurred_at >= now() - interval '1 day'
  group by 1
)
select
  c.id, c.category, c.type, c.title,
  coalesce(ent.entries, 0) as entries_24h,
  coalesce(ev.imps, 0) as imps,
  coalesce(ev.prof, 0) as profile_clicks,
  coalesce(ev.saves, 0) as saves,
  coalesce(ev.dms, 0) as dms,
  coalesce(cv.purchases, 0) as purchases,
  coalesce(cv.revenue, 0) as revenue,
  coalesce(cv.line_adds, 0) as line_adds,
  coalesce(cv.dls, 0) as dls
from campaigns c
left join ent on ent.campaign_id = c.id
left join ev on ev.campaign_id = c.id
left join cv on cv.campaign_id = c.id
where c.status = 'active'
order by c.category, c.type;
